quality_guards: Work-related stress risk depends on job demands, control, support, relationships, role clarity, change, worker factors and organisational context.
HSE stress evidence is organisation-, role-, worker-, control-, assessment- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level mental-health probability.
Heat risk depends on process heat, weather, humidity, work rate, clothing, PPE, acclimatisation, health and exposure duration.
HSE temperature evidence is workplace-, process-, worker-, clothing-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level illness probability.
Violence risk depends on sector, task, location, lone working, client behaviour, staffing, communication, training and emergency support.
HSE violence evidence is workplace-, task-, worker-, customer-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level assault probability.
Occupational-asthma risk depends on sensitiser, concentration, route, exposure duration, controls, susceptibility, surveillance and diagnosis.
HSE asthma evidence is substance-, process-, workplace-, worker-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level disease probability.
Measles risk depends on vaccination, immunity, contact intensity, setting, travel, infectious timing, age and host vulnerability.
UKHSA measles evidence is case-, contact-, vaccine-, setting-, travel- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Rubella risk depends on immunity, vaccination, pregnancy, contact intensity, setting, laboratory confirmation and timing.
UKHSA rubella evidence is case-, contact-, pregnancy-, vaccine-, surveillance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Pertussis risk depends on age, vaccination, contact intensity, setting, symptom timing, testing, treatment and infant exposure.
UKHSA pertussis evidence is case-, contact-, vaccine-, setting-, laboratory- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Blind-cord risk depends on cord design, loop accessibility, fixing strength, furniture position, child age, supervision and product condition.
OPSS blind evidence is product-, installation-, child-, household-, corrective-action- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level strangulation probability.
Turbulence risk depends on weather, aircraft, route, altitude, warning time, restraint use, cabin activity and crew response.
CAA cabin evidence is flight-, aircraft-, passenger-, weather-, reporting- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Train-protection risk depends on signalling, speed profile, equipment fitment, system availability, driver response, infrastructure and operating context.
ORR train-protection evidence is route-, system-, train-, operator-, event- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
